title: School: drop-off, pick-up and messages
intro: Short lines for the school gate, the teacher and other parents. The reading practice uses messages like the ones that come through the school app and the class group chat.

notes.title: juf and meester
body: Children call a female teacher juf and a male teacher meester, often with the first name: juf Sanne, meester Tim. Parents use the same words.

notes.title: brengen and ophalen
body: Brengen is dropping off. Ophalen is picking up. Ophalen is a split verb, so “op” jumps to the end in a simple sentence.

examples.en: Who is picking her up today?

cards.nl: Ik haal haar om drie uur op.
cards.en: I'll pick her up at three.
Who is picking her up today?

reply.nl: Oeps! Ik haal hem straks op.
reply.en: Oops! I'll pick it up later.

cards.en: Tomorrow is a teacher training day, so no school.

cards.nl: Hoe gaat het met haar in de klas?
cards.en: How is she doing in class?

reply.nl: Het gaat goed. Ze speelt veel met Noor.
reply.en: She's doing well. She plays with Noor a lot.

cards.nl: Kan ik u na school even spreken?
cards.en: Could I talk to you for a moment after school?

cards.nl: Wil ze een keer bij ons komen spelen?
cards.en: Would she like to come and play at our house some time?

cards.nl: Mag Noor bij ons komen spelen?
cards.en: Can Noor come and play at our house?

cards.nl: Ze trakteert vrijdag in de klas.
cards.en: She's handing out treats in class on Friday.

readings.title: Uitje naar de kinderboerderij
text: Volgende week woensdag gaan we met de klas naar de kinderboerderij. We vertrekken om half negen en we zijn om twaalf uur terug.
Geef uw kind een tussendoortje en een fles water mee. Doe uw kind laarzen aan, want het kan modderig zijn.
We zoeken nog twee ouders die kunnen rijden. Kunt u helpen? Stuur mij dan een berichtje.
translation: Next Wednesday the class is going to the petting farm. We leave at half past eight and we'll be back at twelve.
Give your child a snack and a bottle of water to take along. Put boots on your child, because it may be muddy.
We're still looking for two parents who can drive. Can you help? Then send me a message.

glossary.en: to give someone something to take along

questions.q: What is the teacher asking for?
When will the class be back?
options: At the end of the school day

readings.title: Wie heeft de blauwe trui gezien?
text: Daan is gisteren na de gym zijn blauwe trui kwijtgeraakt. Heeft iemand hem misschien per ongeluk mee naar huis genomen? Er staat een D op het etiket.
translation: Yesterday after PE, Daan lost his blue sweater. Did someone maybe take it home by mistake? There's a D on the label.

options: It has a D on the label
It has his full name on it
It has a hole in it
